facts.fact: The RTI Commission's legal manager Stephen Owusu spoke of the Right to Information Act, 2019 (Act 989) being implemented, with a revised Legislative Instrument to resolve its implementation gaps.

The Right to Information Commission, which has a new Board, is reported as existing and working on a revised Legislative Instrument for Act 989, stalled in Parliament in late 2024 and not yet resubmitted.

GHA.note: Document does not mention local government office connection.
Consultations mentioned were on an RTI regulation, not a digital law or policy; the conference is on information disorder with no named law.
